intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes resource leak bugs by adding proper cleanup of video buffers and power management references on all error exit paths
intent_record.what: Restructured error handling paths in uvc_start_streaming_video(): changed direct returns on errors to goto-based cleanup labels (err_pm, err_buffers), added uvc_pm_put() call on streaming failure path, and ensured uvc_queue_return_buffers() is called on all error exits
intent_record.how: Ensures proper resource cleanup when stream initialization fails: video buffers are returned to queued state and power management references are released via uvc_pm_put(), preventing resource leaks on error paths

vuln_statements.explanation: This buffer state validation check at line 166 lacks proper synchronization and state transition handling. In the UVC driver context, this check can lead to race conditions where the buffer state may change between validation and subsequent operations, potentially causing use-after-free or memory corruption vulnerabilities when the streaming state is not properly validated before accessing buffer resources.
